lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents in 2026 (DOSM mid-year estimate) per km² of the district that covers most of the hex, measured on the district boundary. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Population change
lenses.description: Population change from 2021 to 2026 (DOSM mid-year estimates) in the district that covers most of the hex. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Non-citizens
lenses.description: Non-citizens ÷ all residents of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM estimate). DOSM's district table does not break non-citizens down by ethnic group, so they are shown here rather than in the Ethnicity lenses.
lenses.note: Share of all residents, not a head count.

lenses.name: Malay
lenses.description: Malay citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Other Bumiputera
lenses.description: Other Bumiputera citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). DOSM counts the many indigenous peoples of Sabah and Sarawak (among them the Iban, Kadazan-Dusun, Bidayuh, Bajau and Melanau) and the Orang Asli of the peninsula together as Other Bumiputera. Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Chinese
lenses.description: Chinese citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Indian
lenses.description: Indian citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Other citizens
lenses.description: Other citizens citizens ÷ all citizens of the district that covers most of the hex (2026 DOSM mid-year estimate, by DOSM's ethnic groups). Every ethnicity lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of citizens (2026), not a head count; non-citizens are in their own lens.

lenses.name: Islam
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Islam ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: Christianity
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Christianity ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: Buddhism
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Buddhism ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: Hinduism
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Hinduism ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: Other religions
lenses.description: Residents recorded under Other religions ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: No religion or unknown
lenses.description: Residents recorded under no religion or unknown religion ÷ all residents, citizens and non-citizens, of the district that covers most of the hex (2020 Population and Housing Census). Every religion lens uses the same colour scale, 0 to 100%.
lenses.note: Share of all residents (2020 Census), not a head count; one figure per district.

lenses.name: Income
lenses.unit: median gross monthly household income, RM
lenses.description: Median gross monthly household income in 2024 (DOSM Household Income and Expenditure Survey) in the district that covers most of the hex. Where a district is made of several survey districts (the parents of the districts created in 2025) the figure is the population-weighted mean of them. Where that happens the median is the weighted mean of the medians, an approximation. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.unit: share of households in absolute poverty
lenses.description: Share of households below the national poverty line income in 2024 (HIES, absolute poverty) in the district that covers most of the hex. Where a district is made of several survey districts (the parents of the districts created in 2025) the figure is the population-weighted mean of them. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Inequality
lenses.description: Gini coefficient of household income in 2024 (HIES; 0 = everyone earns the same) in the district that covers most of the hex. A Gini can not be combined, so districts made of several survey districts have no value. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Unemployed persons ÷ labour force in 2024 (Labour Force Survey) in the district that covers most of the hex. Perlis, Kuala Lumpur, Labuan and Putrajaya show their state's rate. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: GDP per resident
lenses.description: District GDP in 2020 at constant 2015 prices ÷ its residents that year, for the district that covers most of the hex. Output is counted where it is produced, so districts with big industry or commuters read high. Offshore oil and gas is in no district; Putrajaya's output is in Kuala Lumpur's (Putrajaya shows no value). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Tree cover
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in trees (Sentinel-2 10 m land cover, 7 samples per hex). The map counts oil-palm and rubber estates as trees, so this is not natural forest.

lenses.name: Cropland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in cropland such as paddy and vegetables (Sentinel-2 10 m land cover, 7 samples per hex). Oil-palm and rubber estates are counted as trees, not here.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land samples in built-up land (Sentinel-2 10 m land cover, 7 samples per hex).
